user.description: Pick your scooter. It advertises its serial number as its Bluetooth name.

credentials.description: Enter the Bluetooth password for {name}. This is the 16-byte password the Segway app negotiated when it paired; this integration never pairs on its own, because a paired scooter ignores attempts to set a new password.

data_description.password: 32 hexadecimal characters, or 24 characters of base64.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter password
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the stored password. If the scooter was reset and paired with the Segway app again, extract the new password and enter it here.

data_description.password: 32 hexadecimal characters, or 24 characters of base64.

error.invalid_password_format: That is not a 16-byte password. Enter 32 hexadecimal characters or 24 characters of base64.
error.not_paired: The scooter has no password set. Pair it with the Segway app first, then extract the password the app stored.
error.busy: The scooter is connected to something else, most likely the Segway app. Close the app and try again.
error.not_in_range: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy can currently connect to the scooter. Move a proxy closer, or wake the scooter, and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the scooter.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this scooter is already in progress.
abort.no_devices_found: No connectable Bluetooth devices were found.

data.fast_interval: Poll interval while charging or switched on

data_description.slow_interval: Each poll briefly takes the scooter's only Bluetooth connection, so the Segway app may see it as busy for a few seconds.
data_description.fast_interval: Used while the battery is charging or the scooter is switched on.
data_description.stale_after: Readings are kept through failed polls, such as while you are out riding. After this long without a fresh reading they become unavailable. 0 keeps them indefinitely.

not_in_range.message: The scooter is not in range of any Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

busy.message: The scooter is connected to something else, most likely the Segway app.

auth_failed.message: The scooter rejected the stored password.
